entities.name: Antonio de Castro y Casaléiz
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antonio de Castro y Casaleiz was a Spanish politician and diplomat who served, in 1898, as Consul-General of Spain in Cairo. He also acted briefly as Spanish Foreign Minister in 1903 and 1905.
